about: Where a kiosk's kitchen bon goes (printing.bonOnKiosk, off by default; pos-server docs/SPEC_KIOSK.md §5). The same bytes in pos-android app/src/test/resources and pos-server kiosk-desktop/test/fixtures; Android domain/KioskOrders.kt KioskBon.route + ownShare + isOwnPrinter, kiosk-desktop core/kioskBonRoute.ts. single: one named bon printer (bonMode single); singleOwn: that printer is the kiosk's own (its USB port or head, hosted by it, or a receipt printer set to it alone — the Windows kiosk prints everything on its own); kitchenPrinters: the kitchen printers that may take the kiosk's orders; ownPrinter: the kiosk has a printer of its own that would take it (Android: its USB printer; Windows: always).
